snippet.title: Play Crayola Scribble Scrubbie+ Now on Apple Arcade!
snippet.description:
Care for over 95+ pets, each ready to be styled, washed, and endlessly played with! https://rgco.link/ss-arcade-yt

Customize your furry friends with vibrant colors, fun patterns, and creative flair to match your unique style.

Explore a world of creativity and play with a variety of hands-on activities—give your pets a colorful makeover in 3D Coloring, give them a wash at the Pet Washing Station, help your pets feel their best at the Pet Vet, and so much more!

Discover four charming 3D worlds, perfect for pretend play with your favorite pets! From the bustling Main Street and the wild Safari, to the icy Arctic and the magical Peculiar Falls, each world is packed with activities and surprises! Let’s go exploring!

Play now: https://rgco.link/ss-arcade-yt
